entries.title: Acts 10:1
segments: And a certain man named Cornelius was in Caesarea, a centurion of the Italian cohort,

entries.title: Acts 10:2
segments: [one] devout and fearing God, with all his household, both doing many merciful deeds to the people, and praying continually to God.

entries.title: Acts 10:3
segments: About the ninth hour of the day he saw plainly in a vision an angel of God coming to him and saying to him, Cornelius!

entries.title: Acts 10:4
segments: And he was gazing at him, and becoming terrified, he said, What is it, lord? And he said to him, Your prayers and your merciful deeds have come up for a memorial before God.

entries.title: Acts 10:5
segments: And now send men to Joppa and call for Simon, whose last name is Peter.

entries.title: Acts 10:6
segments: He is staying with one Simon a tanner, whose house is by [the] seaside. He will tell you what you must do.

entries.title: Acts 10:7
segments: And when the angel who spoke to Cornelius departed, he called two of his servants and a devout soldier from those who waited on him continually.

entries.title: Acts 10:8
segments: And explaining all things to them, he sent them to Joppa.

entries.title: Acts 10:9
segments: On the next day, as these went on [the] road, and drawing near the city, Peter went up on the housetop to pray, about [the] sixth hour.

entries.title: Acts 10:10
segments: And he became very hungry and desired to eat. But while they made ready, an ecstasy fell on him.

entries.title: Acts 10:11
segments: And he saw the heaven opened and a certain vessel like a sheet coming down to him, being bound at the four corners and let down to the earth;

entries.title: Acts 10:12
segments: in which were all the four-footed animals of the earth, and the wild beasts, and the reptiles, and the birds of the heaven.

entries.title: Acts 10:13
segments: And a voice came to him, saying, Rise, Peter! Kill and eat!

entries.title: Acts 10:14
segments: But Peter said, Not so, Lord, for I have never eaten anything that is common or unclean.

entries.title: Acts 10:15
segments: And the voice [spoke] to him again the second [time], What God has made clean, you do not call common.

entries.title: Acts 10:16
segments: This happened three [times], and the vessel was received up again into the heaven.

entries.title: Acts 10:17
segments: And while Peter doubted within himself what the vision which he had seen might be, even behold, the men who were sent from Cornelius had asked for Simon's house and stood on the porch.

entries.title: Acts 10:18
segments: And they called and asked if Simon whose last name is Peter was staying there.

entries.title: Acts 10:19
segments: And [while] Peter thought on the vision, the Spirit said to him, Behold, three men are looking for you.

entries.title: Acts 10:20
segments: Therefore arise and go down and go with them without doubting, for I have sent them.

entries.title: Acts 10:21
segments: And going down to the men, those sent to him from Cornelius, Peter said, Behold, I am [the one] you are seeking. For what reason have you come?

entries.title: Acts 10:22
segments: And they said, Cornelius the centurion, a just man and [one] who fears God, and one of good report among all the nation of the Jews, was warned from God by a holy angel to send for you to come to his house and to hear words from you.

entries.title: Acts 10:23
segments: Then he called them in and lodged [them]. And on the next day Peter went away with them, and certain brothers from Joppa went with him.

entries.title: Acts 10:24
segments: And the next day they entered into Caesarea. And Cornelius was waiting for them, and had called together his kinsmen and near friends.

entries.title: Acts 10:25
segments: And as Peter was coming in, Cornelius met him and fell down at [his] feet [and] worshiped.

entries.title: Acts 10:26
segments: But Peter took him up, saying, Stand up! I also am a man myself.

entries.title: Acts 10:27
segments: And as he talked with him, he went in and found many who had come together.

entries.title: Acts 10:28
segments: And he said to them, You know that it is an unlawful thing for a man, a Jew to keep company with or to come near to one of another nation. But God has shown me not to call any man common or unclean.

entries.title: Acts 10:29
segments: Therefore I came without complaint, being sent for. I ask, then, for what reason have you sent for me.

entries.title: Acts 10:30
segments: And Cornelius said, Four days ago I was fasting until this hour. And at the ninth hour I prayed in my house, and behold, a man stood before me in bright clothing.

entries.title: Acts 10:31
segments: And he said, Cornelius, your prayer is heard, and your merciful deeds have been remembered before God.

entries.title: Acts 10:32
segments: Therefore send to Joppa and call here Simon whose last name is Peter, he is staying in [the] house of Simon, a tanner by the seaside; who, when he comes, shall speak to you.

entries.title: Acts 10:33
segments: Therefore I immediately sent to you, and you have done well [to] come. Now therefore we are all here present before God to hear all things that are commanded you by God.

entries.title: Acts 10:34
segments: Then Peter opened [his] mouth and said, Truly I see that God is no respecter of persons;

entries.title: Acts 10:35
segments: but in every nation he who fears Him and works righteousness is accepted with Him.

entries.title: Acts 10:36
segments: You know the word which [God] sent to the sons of Israel, preaching the gospel of peace by Jesus Christ (He is Lord of all!);

entries.title: Acts 10:37
segments: that word which was published throughout all Judea, and began from Galilee, after the baptism which John proclaimed;

entries.title: Acts 10:38
segments: how God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with [the] Holy Spirit and with power, and He went about doing good, and healing all those who were oppressed by the Devil, for God was with Him.

entries.title: Acts 10:39
segments: And we are witnesses of all things which He did, both in the land of the Jews and in Jerusalem. They killed [Him] and hanged [Him] on a tree;

entries.title: Acts 10:40
segments: but God raised Him up the third day and showed Him openly,

entries.title: Acts 10:41
segments: not to all the people, but to witnesses hand-picked before by God, [even] to us who ate and drank with Him after He rose from [the] dead.

entries.title: Acts 10:42
segments: And He commanded us to preach to the people, and to testify that it is He who was ordained of God [to be] the Judge of [the] living and [the] dead.

entries.title: Acts 10:43
segments: All the prophets give witness to Him, [that] through His name whoever believes in Him [shall] receive remission of sins.

entries.title: Acts 10:44
segments: While Peter was still speaking these words, the Holy Spirit fell on all those hearing the Word.

entries.title: Acts 10:45
segments: And those of the circumcision, who believed (as many as came with Peter), were astonished because the gift of the Holy Spirit was poured out on the nations also.

entries.title: Acts 10:46
segments: For they heard them speak with tongues and magnify God. Then Peter answered,

entries.title: Acts 10:47
segments: Can anyone forbid water that these, who have received the Holy Ghost as well as we, should not be baptized?

entries.title: Acts 10:48
segments: And he commanded them to be baptized in the name of the Lord. Then they begged him to stay certain days.
